review.summary: Orange/cream packaging colors and sealed silhouette are correct, but the whole pouch retains conspicuous angular facets under PBR. Both exact standard source preparation and explicit custom-normal reset diagnostics retain that faceted appearance. Reject m1 texture-source for a second shape within the existing budget. Hold publication until the S08 body texture GPU request has finished. S08 GPU texture has now completed successfully with an empty queue; release this held rejection.

issues.problem: Large angular/faceted folds throughout the pouch depart materially from the smooth crinkled plastic reference.

review.summary: Closed inflated snack pouch has intact upper/lower crimped seams and coherent front/back volume in five clay views. Creases are stronger/angular and the lower fold is deeper than the reference, to reassess under actual PBR.

issues.problem: More faceted creases and a deeper shaded lower fold than the source photo.

review.summary: 14375triangle second-shape pouch retains continuous flexible-film shading, inflated volume, both crimped seams and orange/cream diagonal design. Five-view comparison and fresh FBX/GLB checks pass; no major new bake defect or part loss.

issues.problem: Deeper side/bottom folds, stronger gloss and slight seal-edge softening remain minor differences.

review.summary: Second shape/texture has substantially smoother continuous plastic highlights than m1, retaining orange film, diagonal cream band, inflated volume and two crimped seams. Five views read as a flexible sealed snack pouch rather than a faceted rigid shell.

issues.problem: Side/bottom folds are deeper and orange/gloss slightly stronger than the reference; minor variation.

review.summary: Second shape has a broader smooth central pouch surface and fewer large facets than m1, while retaining inflated volume and both crimped seams. Inspect actual PBR before final acceptance.

issues.problem: Some angular creases and deeper bottom folds remain; material-stage comparison is required.
